bias.en: Bearish · rebound above the 10-day, under the SAR
bias.zh: 偏空 · 反弹站上 10 日均线，仍低于 SAR

read.en: The Nasdaq ADS rose 1.9% on Oct 27 to $145.36, trading between $143.91 and $146.89 on 1.3 times average volume, with no 100-day yet (77 sessions). It is above the falling 5-day ($140.0) and 10-day ($141.3) averages and below the falling 30-day ($168.9). MACD has been below its signal since Sep 28, below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 7 ($148.53), and RSI is 41.
read.zh: 纳斯达克 ADS 10月27日上涨 1.9%，收于 $145.36，盘中区间 $143.91–146.89，成交量为均量的 1.3 倍；上市仅 77 个交易日，尚无 100 日均线。股价位于下行的 5 日（$140.0）和 10 日均线（$141.3）上方，低于下行的 30 日均线（$168.9）。MACD 自 9月28日起位于信号线及零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月7日起看空（$148.53），RSI 为 41。

read.en: The close cleared the $143.5 Oct 26 high, now support; the high stalled at $146–146.9. Resistance is $146–146.9 (Oct 15, 21 and 27 highs), then $148–148.5 (Oct 19 high, SAR) and $152.4 (Oct 14 high). Support is $143.5–143.9 (Oct 26 high, Oct 27 low), then $140–141.3 (5 and 10-day) and $137.1–137.8. A close above $146.9 would target $148.5–152; below $143.5, $140.

bias.en: Bearish, improving · SAR flipped bullish above ₩1.33 million
bias.zh: 偏空但改善 · 站上 133 万韩元，SAR 转多

read.en: SK hynix rose 5.2% in Seoul on Oct 27 to ₩1,341,000 from ₩1,275,000, after a ₩1,336,000–1,381,000 range. It is above the rising 5-day (₩1,291,400) and falling 10-day (₩1,278,500), and below the falling 30-day (₩1,584,730) and 100-day (₩1,848,800) and the rising 200-day (₩1,484,370). MACD has been below its signal and zero since Oct 6, histogram narrowing toward a cross; Parabolic SAR turned bullish on Oct 27 (₩1,175,200), and RSI is 39.

The jump cleared ₩1.28 million, ₩1,315,000 and the ₩1.33 million October highs, now support, and turned the SAR bullish. Resistance is ₩1,381,000 (Oct 27 high), then ₩1,402,000 (Oct 14 low) and ₩1,484,370–1,497,000 (200-day, Oct 14 high). Support is ₩1,315,000–1,336,000 (October highs, Oct 27 low), then ₩1,278,500–1,291,400 (5 and 10-day) and ₩1.25 million. A close above ₩1,381,000 would target ₩1.40–1.48 million; below ₩1.31 million, ₩1.28 million.
